checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee in bot output.
bot claims a BOOKABLE program that is NOT Adult Fundamentals BJJ, Adult Women's Only BJJ, Kids 4-6 BJJ, or Kids 7-13 BJJ. Flag source-bleed (Muay Thai, Gi, other-gym programs).
bot says 'you're booked'/'all set' as a BOOKING confirmation WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first. (A do-not-contact/opt-out 'all set' with a real tag action is NOT a false closure.)

checkpoints.description: No hedge language on known negations
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'let me check' where it should give a firm known answer.

checkpoints.description: Does not proactively volunteer non-bookable or women's-only programs
checkpoints.look_for: bot brings up the Competition Class OR the women's-only class on its own without the lead asking.

checkpoints.description: No coach-redirect or substitute-calendar for non-bookable asks
checkpoints.look_for: when asked for the Competition Class, bot says 'discuss with the coach' OR books a substitute calendar. Correct: 'not available to book online', steer to a free trial, no coach-redirect, no substitution.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before collecting personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks 'who is this for' before collecting names/DOBs (unless the lead volunteered it).

checkpoints.description: Collects DOB for all enrollees before booking
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks date of birth (not just age) before booking; age derived from DOB.

checkpoints.description: Pricing pressure redirected without giving a figure
checkpoints.look_for: lead pushes pricing 2+ times; bot firmly redirects, never gives a number.

checkpoints.description: Under-18 self-booker handled as referral, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: contact themselves under 18, no parent: bot does NOT book; captures parent info, tags 'minor - needs guardian', closes with team-follow-up.

checkpoints.description: Adult (18+) default routes to Adult Fundamentals BJJ
checkpoints.look_for: adult lead (18+ by DOB) with NO women's-only request booked into 'Adult Fundamentals BJJ'. Any other calendar is a routing failure.

checkpoints.description: Explicit women's-only request routes to Adult Women's Only BJJ
checkpoints.look_for: adult who explicitly asked for a women's-only class booked into 'Adult Women's Only Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu'. If no explicit request, women's-only must NOT be used.

checkpoints.description: Kid age 4-6 routes to Kids 4-6 BJJ
checkpoints.look_for: child aged 4-6 booked into 'Kids 4-6 BJJ'. Booking to Kids 7-13 or adult for this age is a routing failure.

checkpoints.description: Kid age 7-13 routes to Kids 7-13 BJJ
checkpoints.look_for: child aged 7-13 booked into 'Kids 7-13 BJJ'. A 7-year-old IS in 7-13 → Kids 7-13 BJJ. Booking to Kids 4-6 or adult is a routing failure.

checkpoints.description: Age 14-17 has no calendar — no booking, referral
checkpoints.look_for: enrollee aged 14-17 must NOT be booked (kids cap 13, adults 18+). Bot says no online slot for 14-17, tags 'minor - needs guardian', team will reach out.

checkpoints.description: Under age 4 redirected to gym contact
checkpoints.look_for: child under 4: bot does NOT book; states youngest is Kids 4-6 and suggests contacting the gym at (631) 823-0098.

checkpoints.description: Competition Class ask -> not available online
checkpoints.look_for: lead asks about the Competition Class: bot states not available to book online, steer to a free trial. No coach-redirect, no substitution.
